Divas Interior Design
Advertiser: Diva's Interior Design
Started: 6 May 2026
Lighting is often overlooked, but it’s one of the most
important elements in a home. In this project, we focused on
layering different types of lighting — from soft cove lighting
to under-cabinet strips and feature highlights — to create
depth and improve how each space feels throughout the day.
It’s not just about brightness. Good lighting enhances
textures, defines zones, and makes your home feel more
comfortable and complete. If you’re planning your renovation,
don’t leave lighting as an afterthought — it can completely
change the way you experience your space. 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐦𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐨𝐟
